evals.prompt: I have an old Weave project my-team/legacy-bot that only logged @weave.op calls. I want that history to show up in the Agents tab. Please convert 2026-08-01 into a new project my-team/legacy-bot-agents.
evals.expected_output: Uses the calls-to-agent-spans converter. Dry-run first against a new target project. Does not write to the source. Does not mention storage engines or edit span_builder. Tells the user to open the Agents tab and check turn text, tools, and cost.
expectations: The solution runs scripts/convert_calls_to_agent_spans.py with --dry-run before any write
source-project is my-team/legacy-bot and target-project is a different project (my-team/legacy-bot-agents)
The response does not write to the source project and does not tell the user to edit span_builder.py
The response does not mention ClickHouse, table names, or semconv.py in the primary steps
The user is told to open the target in the Agents tab and confirm user text, assistant reply, tools, and cost

evals.prompt: Dry-run coverage listed missing_user: ["orchestrator"]. The root op takes a `task` argument. How do I fix the mapping and continue?
evals.expected_output: Adds --user-path inputs.task (or the path to USER_TEXT_PATHS) and dry-runs again. Does not rewrite span classification.
expectations: The solution passes --user-path inputs.task or adds inputs.task to USER_TEXT_PATHS
It dry-runs again and only then drops --dry-run
It does not invent assistant text or edit span_builder.py classification
